title: Catalpa asset identity registry version 1
description: Registers identity and content versions only. Missing dependencies remain diagnostics. Source provenance and import settings are retained without modifying original data. The loader also rejects duplicate IDs/locators, self dependencies and undeclared mounts.

schemaVersion.description: The C++ reader additionally requires an integer JSON token, so 1.0 is rejected.

path.description: Canonical mount:/relative path; source mounts must be declared in the project, cooked locators use cooked:/ .

version.description: An exact integer JSON token is required; floating point tokens are rejected.

importSettings.description: Preserved bounded author data; importer-specific validation is performed by the future importer.
